rules_text: A row is IMPROVED only when a previously FAIL or NOT RUN row now PASSes AND the stimulus was established in both runs, the observer, oracle, driver and harness are the same (or attested the same) in both runs, the media / capture binding is the same, the row was not omitted by design or interrupted, and both original receipts are in the bundle.

A row is REGRESSED only when a previously PASS row now FAILs under the same valid conditions. A FAIL that was already a FAIL is never a regression, and an unchanged FAIL on an oracle the owner or analyst disputes is reported as 'not scored'.

A journey or area is UNCHANGED when every row that has a verdict in either run has the same verdict in both runs and no condition below applies. NOT RUN in both runs means no signal in either run: it is shown as unresolved, not as a pass.

INCONCLUSIVE means not comparable. It applies whenever the stimulus was not established in either run, the observer, oracle, harness or driver changed or cannot be shown to be the same, the media / capture binding differs, the row was omitted by design or interrupted by an allowance, the run's original receipt or binding manifest is not in the bundle, or the row is not in both runs.
NOT RUN replacing a PASS or FAIL is COVERAGE LOST. It is inconclusive and never an improvement, even though the FAIL count falls.

Journey class: regressed if any row regressed; otherwise inconclusive if any changed row is inconclusive or any journey-level condition applies; otherwise improved if any row improved; otherwise unchanged. Area class uses the same precedence over the area's requirement rows that have a verdict in either run; an area with no such row is inconclusive (no signal).
